body.objective: Exact polynomial-ideal and Groebner-basis machinery over Q, with a declared monomial order, reduction and ideal-membership witnesses, elimination support, and an independently checkable basis certificate. This blocks the Paper-13 a,d times ell=2 extra polynomial zero-locus stratum in bridge/certificates/einstein_maxwell_weyl_ad_ell2_extra_polynomial_zero_locus.json and is the V1 adoption scout's M12 blocker. The installed msolve 0.9.4 C API is a candidate exact producer, but the Forge result and checker must use canonical Forge polynomial data rather than trusting an external transcript.
body.stop_condition: a Forge gate reconstructs the committed Paper-13 ideal without running physics-repo Python, computes the declared reduced Groebner basis and zero-locus stratum, verifies the basis by exact S-polynomial/reduction and bidirectional ideal-membership witnesses, and cross-checks the certificate's embedded basis and monomial order; a decisive coefficient or exponent mutation is rejected
body.forbid: floating-point coefficient paths; treating an msolve or other external-library rerun as independent verification; silently assuming the ideal is zero-dimensional; changing variable or monomial order without recording the crosswalk; hiding the external dependency version or licence; promoting the algebraic stratum to bounded, causal, nonlinear-all-order or physical-branch conclusions
